annotations.target_phrase: The Villa Straylight was a parasitic structure, Case reminded himself, as he stepped past the tendrils of caulk
annotations.annotation_text: Villa Straylight as an architectural parasite: grafted onto the tip of Freeside, leeching air and water without producing anything, symbolizing the terminal decadence of dynastic monopoly capitalism.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 243.
